title: Horizon Scanning 2026
discussion_signal: The post interprets UN horizon scanning as a shift from treating AI and data technologies as discrete tools toward seeing them as system-level infrastructures. It connects that shift to governance, equity, scientific capacity, science-policy interfaces, sustainability, health, and human security.
linked_research_question: How does anticipatory governance respond when emerging technologies become infrastructures that reorganize institutional power and preparedness?
limits: Individual professional interpretation of a UN report
No evidence here of implementation by governments or institutions
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative deliberative process
